description_en: Queries the IDs, editions, remarks, and IP type information of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的ID、版本、备注、IP类型信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-instance-ids --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --edition 9 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceIds

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query. Valid values:

0: Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) Insurance mitigation plan.
1: Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) Unlimited mitigation plan.
2: Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) acceleration line.
3: Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) secure acceleration line.
9: Anti-DDoS Pro (the Chinese mainland) Professional edition
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的类型。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
3：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）安全加速线路。
9：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query. Maximum value of N: 200
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。N的最大值：200
parameters.name: instance_ids
